sections.title: Tanul and gyakorol
sections.content: *Tanul* (learns) and *gyakorol* (practises) take the language with *-ul/-ül*, like *beszél*: *Magyarul tanulok.* (I am learning Hungarian.) *Angolul gyakorolok.* (I practise English.) You know these verbs from the present tense: *tanulok, tanulsz, tanul*; *gyakorolok, gyakorolsz, gyakorol*.

sections.title: Practise with a person
sections.content: Say who with the ending *-val/-vel* you know: *Annával gyakorolok.* (I practise with Anna.) A *nyelvcsere* is a language exchange: each person helps the other with their language.

items.english: There is a language exchange in the café.

sections.content: The language word goes with *tanul* just as with *beszél*: *Magyarul tanulok*, not *Magyar tanulok*.
